sentences.text:
High Court Of Andhra Pradesh
 Main Case No: W.P.No.1489 of 2025
 Proceeding Sheet

NOTE 02. 10.02.2025 BVLNC,J  Heard Sri N. Ravi Prasad learned  counsel for the petitioner, learned counsel  representing Deputy Solicitor General of India  appearing for respondent Nos.1 & 2 and learned counsel for Additional Government Pleader representing the State.
Sri N. Ravi Prasad, learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that the petitioner herein is arrayed as A4 in Crime No.324 of 2022 under Section 498A IPC and Sections 3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.
The petitioner herein filed an application before the jurisdictional Magistrate vide Crl.M.P. No.4405 of 2023 seeking permission to go abroad to join her husband.

Learned Magistrate vide Order dated 06.12.2024, permitted the petitioner and her baby to go abroad to join her husband, but the petitioner is not allowed to go abroad on the ground that look notice vide C.No.1201/C61/IP/CID/2023 was issued by respondent No.2, at the instance of respondent No.3 is pending against her and therefore, the present Writ Petition is filed.

Learned counsel for respondent No.3 would submit that if the petitioner makes representation to respondent No.3, necessary steps will be taken for withdrawal of lookout notice, as per the order of the learned Magistrate.

In the light of the above said facts and circumstances, there shall be interim stay of all further proceedings in lookout notice vide C.No.1201/C61/IP/CID/2023 issued by the respondent No.2 against the petitioner herein, until further orders.

For filing Counter Affidavit, list after six (06) weeks.
Petitioner herein is at liberty to make necessary representation to respondent Nos.2 and 3 for withdrawal of lookout notice, in the light of the permission granted by the learned Magistrate to the petitioner to go abroad to join her husband.
